title: Sample Practice Set
description: A short demo set showing text questions, images, topics, and per-choice explanations.

questions.question: Which country is home to the Great Barrier Reef?

choices.explanation: Correct — the reef stretches over 2,300 kilometers along Australia's Queensland coast and is the largest living structure on Earth, visible even from space.
Not quite — Brazil is home to the Amazon rainforest, not the Great Barrier Reef.
Not quite — Canada's coastlines are mostly cold-water marine environments with no reefs of this scale.
Not quite — Japan has coral reefs near Okinawa, but nothing on this scale.

questions.explanation: The Great Barrier Reef lies off the coast of Queensland, Australia.

questions.question: What is the capital of Japan?
questions.explanation: Tokyo became the capital of Japan in 1868.

questions.question: Which gas do plants absorb from the air for photosynthesis?
What is the chemical formula for water?
questions.explanation: Water is made of two hydrogen atoms bonded to one oxygen atom.
